description.text: This is divided into Elementary Level, Intermediate Level, and Advanced Level. For group study, we can set the study periond according requirement. Duration: Four weeks from mid July Tuition Fee and Others (PAID IN RMB): Tuition: RMB 3000 The Activity Fee: RMB 1000 includes Laoshan trip, Beer Museum, etc(the activities include the tour and the visits arranged in the afternoon and weekends) Accommodations: Facilities in Room: Telephone, TV-set, private toilet, air conditioner, wardrobe and desk, etc. Room Rate (ON CAMPUS, PAID IN RMB): Single room: RMB 120 /day Double room: RMB 80 /day/person Food & Miscellaneous Fee: approx. RMB 2500 four weeks (depending on individual lifestyle) Schedule: The students would take the course according to their Chinese level. And the students should attend the course from 8 am to 12 am, from Monday to Friday, 20 class hours one week. Courses: Oral Chinese, Listening, Comprehensive Reading, Chinese culture, practising Chinese by looking pictures and some related subjects.

duration.text: The Summer Chinese Language Course at Ocean University of China is a 4 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 416 USD/In total ￥ 3000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Resume Written in Chinese and English You can download a template or sample from here 5.Certificate of employment If applicable
